scientific_integrity: The existing periodic-point enumeration and coarse omega-limit classification are credited; new claim is the exact global basin selection with settling-time scale. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only \(0<r<1\) for \(f(x)=\lfloor\mu-rx\rfloor\); logarithmic transient constant depends on parameters; priority of an unread 2025 journal revision cannot be ruled out.
title: Outermost-cycle basin selection and logarithmic settling for quantized affine contractions
